rules.title: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)
rules.requirement: Annual rent increases for RSO units are capped at a set percentage; landlords may no longer add a utilities percentage from February 2, 2026. Landlords may pass through RSO and SCEP surcharges monthly with written notice after registering the units.
rules.key_value: 3% annual allowable increase for 1 Jul 2025 to 30 Jun 2026; RSO surcharge $1.61/month, SCEP surcharge $2.83/month
rules.citation: City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO)

coverage.summary: Applies to rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles RSO.

rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
3%
